prompt: Listen and choose the best response.
promptZh: 請聽錄音，選出最適當的回應。

options.text: Enter fourteen and flag the difference on the note.
options.zh: 填十四箱，並在送貨單上註明差異。
options.whyZh: 按實收箱數登錄並指出和單據的落差。

options.text: Enter fifteen so the figures match.
options.zh: 填十五箱，這樣數字就一致了。
options.whyZh: 雖然和單據一致，卻沒有如實記錄只收到十四箱。

options.text: Leave the line blank until next month.
options.zh: 這一欄先留白，等到下個月。
options.whyZh: 目前已有實點數量；拖到下個月不會記錄差異。

explanationZh: 按實收箱數登錄並指出和單據的落差。
evidence: The delivery note shows fifteen cases, but I counted fourteen. What should I enter? / Enter fourteen and flag the difference on the note.
spokenPrompt: The delivery note shows fifteen cases, but I counted fourteen. What should I enter?
spokenPromptZh: 送貨單寫十五箱，但我數到十四箱。我應該填什麼？
